features: These chocolate minis and large mix are a sweet trip down memory lane, evoking the fond nostalgia of childhood. Indulge yourself in the pleasure of these individually-wrapped, mini and large rolls and savor every chocolaty moment!
2 POUND BULK BAG: Enjoy this bulk mix of large and midgees toosie rolls.
Perfect for school kids, parties, festivities, holiday celebrations, pinatas, and sharing with your cherished family and friends — these treats are a delightful addition to any occasion.
Since 2003, The Hampton Popcorn & Candy Company has been delighting taste buds with a delectable assortment of popcorn and candy treats, perfect for every occasion.
